risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-end GPU (e.g., GTX 950 or 1050 Ti with 2GB) or not working

risks.risk: RAM is less than 16GB or not DDR4
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information or Task Manager showing installed RAM and type.

risks.risk: Storage is not 512GB SSD or is a hybrid drive
risks.proof: Screenshot of Disk Management or system info showing drive type and size.

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., hinge issues, cracked screen, dead pixels)
risks.proof: Close-up of screen for dead pixels, video of hinge movement, and full view of all sides and ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having moderate wear or potential defects

risks.risk: Battery is degraded or not included
risks.proof: Video of battery health in Windows Battery Report or showing battery being removed/installed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery not included or degraded

proof_requests: Screenshot of Device Manager or dxdiag showing exact GPU model and VRAM.
Screenshot of system information showing RAM size and type.
Screenshot of Disk Management showing storage type and size.
Video of laptop hinge movement and close-up of screen for dead pixels.
Photo or video of battery health or confirmation if battery is included.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as an ASUS gaming laptop, but critical specs (CPU, RAM, storage, GPU) cannot be verified from the photos. The NVIDIA Control Panel does not show full system info, and the model is unreadable. Without proof of the claimed specs, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be assessed at worst-case assumptions for each unverified claim.
